overview: Memo is a self-respecting man, with a seemingly settled life. He wants to build a home next to Úrsula, but receiving a letter containing the confession that he has a daughter changes completely the course of his life. Without expecting it, this sudden detour will lead him to love, since, trying to meet little Isabella, he arrives at the Beltrán family's house where he meets Daniela, Isabella's adoptive mother, becoming her confidant and little by little they fall in love. A story that proves that your destination may change its path.
title: Mi Camino es Amarte

overview: Natalia and Adrian are celebrating their twentieth-anniversary party, with their family and closest friends. Adrian and Natalia's best friend Veronica have hatched a plan to flee on the same day of the celebration and once they have swindled the clients of the real estate agency of which they are partners. Meanwhile, Vicente is a victim of fraud and loses everything. Natalia is left with only one house in a popular neighborhood where she must move in with her daughters. When she arrives, she finds out that Vicente is the supposed owner of the house since he signed an invalid sales contract, which makes Natalia the actual owner. Vicente refuses to receive them and Natalia, without hesitating, moves into the house that both will now share with their respective families, causing conflicts between the characters due to social and cultural differences.
title: Mi Fortuna Es Amarte

overview: Mi Pecado revolves around the reunion of Lucrecia and Julián, childhood friends whose love is thwarted by their families and grudges, forcing Lucrecia to marry another man to save her father, while Julián is unjustly accused and flees, condemned to fight against obstacles, secrets, and fate to be together, against the backdrop of the rivalry between the Huerta and Córdoba families in the town of El Milagro, a love that is their "sin" and salvation.
title: Mi Pecado

overview: NFL GameDay Overtime provides the latest reactions and analysts from the Sunday Night Football game as well as all the action from all the Sunday's games.
title: NFL GameDay Overtime

overview: What would you do if you lost everything, and life gives you an opportunity to reinvent yourself and take on a new identity. Valeria and Natalia, two little girls that met at a boarding school are bound by their family's abandonment, which brings them together until both suffer a terrible accident where Valeria is the sole survivor. She must run away, and all she manages to take with her are Natalia's ID documents; she decides to steal her friend's identity without considering the challenges that will come with her new life.
title: Mi Secreto

overview: Emilia Sánchez is a single and resilient mother who works in a mine, where she meets with Leonardo Santamaría, the son of the town's most powerful woman, Roberta Castro. Emilia and Leonardo fall in love, unleashing Roberta's fury. As Roberta discovers that Emilia has exposed her wicked deeds, she seeks revenge to make Emilia's life miserable and destroy her. Emilia survives the hardships but is left with a broken heart, believing Leonardo betrayed her. When everyone believes Emilia has died, she returns to the town to reclaim her son and seek justice. She will make each of her enemies pay for the harm they've inflicted, discovering that love is her only salvation.
title: Minas de Pasión

overview: An innocent young woman committed to caring for her ailing father finds herself helpless after he dies. Her scheming godmother and aunt use her to get rich at all costs. Powerful men desire her obsessively, and even the people she trusts, they all use her to reach their own ambitions. Upon discovering the betrayal of the man she loved, and after she lost her daughter at birth, Lucía transforms into a woman with only one purpose in mind, to use her beauty to take revenge on all the men who hurt her.
title: Mujer de Nadie

overview: Mundo de Fieras focuses on Gabriel, a man from high society who marries the manipulative Joselyn and suffers from her cruelty, until the arrival of the humble tutor Mariángela awakens his love and unleashes his wife's fury, while his twin brother Demián, raised in poverty, seeks revenge against him, revealing a world of passions, intrigues, and fierce creatures in the Bustamante family and its surroundings.
title: Mundo de Fieras

overview: Oriana Caligaris, is happily married to Jose Luis Falcon. They live next to their daughter Alina, in Cartagena, Colombia. All of a sudden, one day everything changes for Oriana when Jose Luis, who works at the Colombian Customs, confesses to her that he has been doing some smuggling activities, and the police are already behind him since he put the earnings he made out of this under her name without her consent, thus, involving her in the business. Disappointed, Oriana escapes to Mexico with her daughter, and looks for her intimate friend Raquel, who owns "El Descanso" hotel in San Carlos, Sonora, together with Lucina. Oriana will have to struggle with her past and her new life.
title: Mentir para Vivir

overview: Mi Destino Eres Tú is about Andrea, a young woman who, after the tragic death of her beloved husband Ramiro, closes her heart and devotes herself to work, but her destiny forces her to open up to love again when two men, Mauricio and Eduardo, enter her life, one of whom is destined to be her true love, despite the pain and guilt she feels.
title: Mi Destino Eres Tu

overview: Yolanda and Javier have been happily married for 17 years and have 2 daughters. But Yolanda doesn't know that Javier is having an affair. Sadly, Yolanda is far from the only woman with that problem.
title: Mujeres Engañadas

overview: "Smosh Summer and Winter Games" formerly titled, "Smosh Seasonal Games" is an event and series of videos uploaded on the Smosh Games and Smosh Pit channels. It sees the entire Smosh Family divide into teams to compete against each other in season related games.
title: Smosh Summer and Winter Games

overview: Courtney Miller interviews famous internet people in order to find out just how Internet-savvy they truly are.
title: URL | SmoshAlike

overview: Grab your favorite snack and join Anthony Padilla, Ian Hecox and their Gen Z producer on their lunch break to chat about who knows what!
title: Lunchtime with Smosh: The Podcast

overview: The story of Ximena and Salvador, two young souls driven by a thirst for justice, their destinies entwined by this common pursuit. Ximena, a mezcal producer presumed dead since childhood, uncovers her true heritage within a family that views her as an adversary. Salvador, an esteemed attorney bound by ethical principles, is the heir to the family that once raised her as a servant, and he finds himself falling deeply in love with her. As her origin is revealed, animosity between the mezcal families resurfaces, separating Ximena and Salvador.
title: Nadie Como Tú

overview: Niña Amada Mía tells the story of Isabela Soriano, a young woman who falls in love with her foreman, Víctor Izaguirre, a forbidden love that defies the strict rules of her father, Clemente Soriano, a controlling rancher who tries to marry her off to a rich man to save the estate, unleashing a whirlwind of passion, secrets, and family conflicts in a rural setting.
title: Niña Amada Mía

overview: Niña de Mi Corazón revolves around Andrea Paz, a young woman who abandons her dreams of going to college to support her family after her father's accident. She becomes entangled in a plot involving identity and romance when she pretends to be a man to work at a company, falling in love with the wealthy heir Darío Arrioja, who mistakes her for a boy while she struggles to protect her secret and her growing love for him.
title: Niña de Mi Corazón

overview: Mauro Montesinos is a widower and owner of a coffee plantation. He falls in love with Florencia Martinez, the owner of some coffee lands next to his plantation. However, the love between Mauro and Florencia is impossible because when they are about to marry, Mauro discovers that Lucrecia, an old friend of his, is pregnant with his child. Mauro and Florencia must separate despite their big love. Thirty years pass, and Florencia and Mauro´s past is brought back to life when Maximiliano Montesino, (Mauro´s son) falls in love with Amaya, Florencia´s daughter. Both must fight against many hardships in order to discovery if their love is stronger than the unfortunate past lived by their parents.
title: Quiero Amarte

overview: The plot centers on Bianca, a young woman harboring deep resentment toward her mother, Flavia Fischer, whom she blames for her father's death; to exact revenge, Bianca marries Ariel Piamonte, Flavia's wealthy husband, and moves into the family estate, where she unexpectedly falls in love with Bruno, Ariel's nephew and the fiancé of her half-sister Penélope. This forbidden romance unfolds amid escalating tensions, including hidden affairs, a shocking pregnancy, and dramatic confrontations that test loyalties and unravel the family's facade of perfection.
title: Pasión Prohibida

overview: Natalia and Adrián are strangers who live in different cities but discover in an instant that they belong together. They were both married for over twenty years, and each has two beautiful young children. Their lives are quite similar—and both are unhappy and frustrated. Destiny brings the two together when they are each on the verge of divorce.
title: Pecados Ajenos

overview: The Battle 4 Atlantis Tournament is an annual seasonal 3-day long preseason Basketball contest where 8 of the greatest college teams in the Nation compete against each other live from the Bahamas.
title: Battle 4 Atlantis Tournament

overview: Lorena and Sara were raised together in an orphanage, and even though they have different personalities, they loved each other as sisters. Lorena dreams of starting her own family and loves to cook, while Sara is more materialistic; she has always hated the poverty of the orphanage, and she has more ambitions than values. Lorena's greatest wish is to become a chef and so, one day she says goodbye to the nuns who raised her at the orphanage and leaves to study cuisine in Mexico City. That same day, Madre Asunción discovers that Sara had stolen some of the funds of the orphanage. However, after she confronts Sara, she suffers a heart attack and dies. To avoid getting caught any further, Sara runs with her lover and accomplice Chalo, who is also the delivery guy/driver of the orphanage. But before she leaves, she goes through the files Madre Asunción had in her office for each orphaned child and stole two files – hers and Lorena's. When she finally reads them, she learns that she was found in the garbage dump, while Lorena was abandoned in the orphanage without explanation by her grandmother, the millionaire Hortensia Vallejo Vda. de Armendáriz. Sara's first impulse is to find Lorena and help her confront her grandmother and demand her rights, but then she reconsiders her options and decides to usurp her place in the Armendáriz gastronomic empire. Believing she would never see Lorena again, Sara thought her plan was foolproof.
title: Querida Enemiga

overview: The love Elsa and Andres feel for each other is pure and selfless, but it is forbidden. Elsa's father, Armando Quiroga, the wealthiest man in town, whom everyone looks up to, will do everything he can to prevent their love. He believes dating between social classes is unacceptable- it goes against his ideals. In their quest for happiness, Elsa and Andres will challenge societal norms and free themselves from the oppressive grip of their families.
title: Perdona Nuestros Pecados

overview: Set in colonial Mexico during the 1740s, Pasión is an epic period drama that follows the arduous love story between Camila Darién and Ricardo de Salamanca. After being separated from her true love, Santiago, and enduring various misfortunes—including being kidnapped by pirates—Camila finds herself entangled with the rugged pirate Ricardo, who is on a quest to reclaim his family's lost fortune. As they navigate a world of sea battles, class struggles, and betrayal, the two must overcome their initial differences and the machinations of their enemies to find a future together, proving that passion can conquer even the most remarkable obstacles.
title: Pasión

overview: Palabra de Mujer focuses on four women from different social classes (Vanesa, Fernanda, Paulina, and Matilde) who come together to face personal and professional challenges, discovering their strength, overcoming romantic disappointments, and seeking personal fulfillment through friendship and empowerment, all while managing complex relationships and fighting for their dreams in a challenging work environment, such as a television production company.
title: Palabra de Mujer

overview: Dramatic anthology with David Niven as host
title: The David Niven Show

overview: Emilia is a woman who, against her mother's will, confronts everything and everyone to pursue her dream of succeeding as a singer. She has a beautiful voice that immediately connects with people and the talent to put music to the words that come from her heart. Although her mother was the one who taught her how to sing, she forbade her from doing it professionally, believing that those who enter that world, full of vices and easy ways, get lost. When Emilia meets Angel, her idol, she finds the strength to pursue her dream without realizing that her voice will give him hope and life. Angel will give her wings and Emilia strength. Still, they must face many obstacles to materialize their love and survive between love and fame.
title: Pienso en Ti

overview: The Barragán and Monsalve families are cousins but enmity under a blood and revenge sentence provoked by Nando when killing his cousin Adriano. Only Arcangel Barragan and Nadia Monsalve with their love can change all.
title: Ojo por Ojo

overview: Wealthy, 35 year-old longtime widow Leonarda Ruán & new guy in town, 20 year-old Genaro Onchi, with nothing to his name, unexpectedly fall deeply in love with each other. Their love is challenged by the very strong disapproval of the small, close-minded conservative town and by two men & three women who each intend to win over Leonarda & Genaro respectively.
title: Pueblo Chico Infierno Grande

overview: Ramona returns to the family home after years of being educated by nuns. Ramona reunites with her mother and brother and childhood friend, the Indian Alejandro. Ramona and Alejandro fall in love and the couple are faced with the prejudices of an interracial couple.
title: Ramona

overview: Ni Contigo, Ni Sin Ti is about Leo, a blind but optimistic man, and Nicole, a resilient woman fleeing a hurricane, who find love in a boarding house filled with quirky tenants; their developing romance faces challenges from societal prejudices, personal secrets, and the meddling of a charming womanizer, Jose Carlos, who becomes obsessed with Nicole, forcing everyone to confront their fears and fight for a love that seems impossible.
title: Ni Contigo, Ni Sin Ti

overview: Each year since 2012, the Global Spin Awards have honored the world's best DJ's for their contribution to the culture of music and entertainment across all genres past, present and future.
title: Global Spin Awards

overview: Ringo tells the story about a retired boxer, Juan José "Ringo" Ramírez, who must return to the ring and fight for custody of his son against his ex-wife and rival, facing economic hardship and personal battles outside the ropes to prove he's a champion in life as well as boxing
title: Ringo

overview: Fernanda Ríos, determined to move past her troubled past, has her plans disrupted when a cruel man enters her life, sparking a chain of events testing her resilience. Complicating matters, she falls for Francisco, driven by vengeance.
title: Sed de Venganza

overview: Peregrina is a love story full of magic and risks taken to achieve happiness. A tragedy befalls the home of millionaire Eliseo: his daughter, Marisela, whom he loves immensely, suffers from a deadly disease. In the little time left to live, Marisela becomes pregnant and, before she dies, gives birth to a baby girl.
title: Peregrina

overview: A woman in Mexico mistreated and abused by her husband abandons him, and goes to Spain where she falls in love and has an affair with another man.
title: Piel de Otoño

overview: Sin Tu Mirada focuses on Marina, a humble young blind woman who develops great sensitivity and falls in love with the wealthy Luis Alberto, facing obstacles due to her disability, her social class, and the intricate secrets of her origins, as she was switched at birth with the son of a wealthy family to ensure a male heir for the Ocaranza family, in a plot of love, prejudice, and destiny.
title: Sin Tu Mirada

overview: Arturo De La Riva has been happily married to Eugenia for 10 years, with whom he has a daughter, named Aranza, however, they do not imagine that Eugenia´s cousin Sonia, is obsessively in love with Arthur in secret, leading her to cause a terrible tragedy. Meanwhile, Isabel Lopez Cerdan spent two years believing she was married to Fernando Cordova, whom she loves above all everything. Eugenia dies unexpectedly at the same that Isabel discovers that Fernando is a scammer. After such hard blows, fate unites Isabel and Arturo on a heavenly beach, giving birth to a relationship that must defeat several hardships such as the manipulation Sonia puts on Aranza to make her reject Isabel, and Fernando´s hunger for revenge.
title: Por Siempre Mi Amor

overview: Four friends, Renata, Maite, Paloma and Fernanda, owners of the women's underwear company "Sin vergüenza" who face love, passion, evil and friendship. They live in Bogota, Colombia.
title: Sin Vergüenza

overview: Tragedy surrounds Azucena's life, as her father was unjustly imprisoned and her mother murdered. The love between Azucena and Daniel will be affected by the revenge of Mariano, who will do everything possible so that they are not happy.
title: Por Un Beso

overview: After living in poverty, Rafaela decides to become a doctor and work at a hospital to carry on. She didn't imagine that at the hospital she would find her true love and the envy of people who never liked her.
title: Rafaela

overview: Alberto and Sofia will live an impossible love story, as fate would have it. In order to save his generations old family business from bankruptcy, Alberto must reach an agreement with their new investors, but they have different plans in mind for the land where the printing press is. Things get even more complicated as Sofia is one of the new investors' daughter. He can't possibly sacrifice his legacy and she is incapable of opposing her father's decisions, so their love is at stake.
title: S.O.S. Me Estoy Enamorando

overview: Access is a daily round-up of the latest showbiz news, gossip and rumours.
title: Access

overview: Valentina Villalba Rangel is a beautiful woman who inherited a large fortune from her parents. When her fiancé Alonso Peñalvert leaves her at the altar, she swears never to let another man toy with her again.
title: Soy tu dueña

overview: Los Plateados were bandits who stole from the routes which transported silver to the states of Guanajuato and Taxco in Mexico. For that reason the bandits were called "the silver plated ones", which means "the silver-plated". It was the social time of the bandits, They would steal from the rich and give to the poor. This soap opera bring that era to us with plenty of excitement and romance.
title: Los Plateados

overview: Elena, Ernesto and Nicolás had been a happy family until Nicolás was diagnosed with leukemia and needed an urgent bone marrow transplant. Ernesto and Elena are compelled to find their son's biological parents as none of the adoptive family members are compatible with him. They are unable to find the mother, but they do find Pedro his father, instead, who is shocked by the news since he had no idea he had a son. Ernesto and Elena are deeply grateful to him but demand him not to have any relationship with Nicolás. He agrees, understanding that Nicolás already has a life with his adoptive family. But fate has other plans and everyone's life will change completely.
title: Te doy la vida

overview: Sofía de la Huerta is a young and kind painter who falls in love with Renato Aramedia without imagining that her love will unleash the hatred of Leonor de la Huerta, her own sister, or that Renato is compulsively jealous.
title: Sentimientos Ajenos

overview: María Teresa, a successful and attractive businesswoman, faces a dilemma when she discovers that her father, Esteban, has been falsely accused of fraud. Determined to clear his name, María Teresa takes charge of "La Esperanza," a coveted property in the village of Puerto Bravo. There, she encounters Santos, the estate's caretaker, who initially perceives her as rude and entitled. Despite their initial differences, María Teresa and Santos join forces to confront Marco, a greedy neighbor attempting to seize control of "La Esperanza," and Rutilio, the town's corrupt mayor. As they battle to safeguard the estate, María Teresa and Santos gradually develop deep feelings for one another, falling in love. Amidst their challenges, their love and the hope embodied by "La Esperanza" become their guiding light in a tempest fueled by passion.
title: Tierra de Esperanza

overview: The life of a happy family is ruined as soon as Mauricio's wife is thought to be dead in a train accident when she was apparently trying to leave her husband.
title: Siempre te amaré

overview: Actor, director, and producer Vojtěch Kotek is embarking on a completely new life project—not only is he building his own farm, but he is also filming a new documentary series about it.
title: Farma Vojty Kotka

overview: Two stories at the same time: the first one is the love between Fernanda (a doctor) and Jose Luis (a teacher). The second one is the story of friendship of 5 schoolgirls in a private school for rich kids.
title: Soñadoras

overview: In 1519, the Mayan priest Ahzac learns that his maiden daughter, Ixmy, has surrendered to the love of a white man, thus betraying her destiny, for she was fated to be sacrificed to the gods, accompanied by an offering of gold and a huge black pearl. Infuriated, Ahzac lays a terrible curse on the treasure: "May happiness never come to those who hold this black pearl in their hands!" In 1987, while Hernan Lazcano and Eliseo Bravo are exploring the Cozumel coral reef, they make an amazing discovery. They find the black pearl, which has lain at the bottom of the sea for five centuries. When Eliseo touches the pearl, unleashing Ahzac's curse, he is suddenly possessed by an overwhelming greed, which makes him cause his partner's death. Hernan's demise will leave his wife Analy and his infant daughter Aymar in abject poverty. Eliseo brings the black pearl and the gold back to Veracruz, but the black pearl´s curse is upon him, and he finds his wife María Teresa gone. She has deserted him and their three sons, David, Nicolas and Leonardo. Eliseo recovers from his pain and, with his new wealth, builds up a prosperous cattle breeding hacienda that lives up to its name: Paradise. However, he keeps the source of his fortune a secret, as well as the dark betrayal caused by the curse of that beautiful pearl. Twenty years go by. Eliseo has raised his sons with an iron fist. His oldest son, David, turns out to be a disappointment to him, for he shows no interest in the hacienda, so Eliseo puts his trust in his second son, Nicolas, an upstanding lawyer who stands squarely behind his father. Leonardo, his youngest son, has a sensitive, melancholy disposition. Aymar, Hernan's daughter, has grown into a beautiful young woman who is proud of her Mayan culture and ancestry. When she and Nicolas meet, they both fall deeply in love with each other. A ravishing beauty called Maura Duran appears on the scene, passing herself off as Karina Rosemberg. Driven by greed, she weaves a web of lies to get her hands on the Bravo fortune. Using her sensual allure, she seduces the three brothers and turns them against each other. Aymar is caught in the middle of Maura's intrigue, and separated from Nicolas. But the love between Nicolas and Aymar has not died. A long and desperate fight awaits them, against Maura's dark machinations and the curse of the black pearl, with love as their only weapon, a love capable of defeating time and evil itself.
title: Tormenta en el Paraiso

overview: Three women who are torn between two loves, what society will say about them and the desire to have the man they love. Each one will find their way to happiness. There will be those who succeed and there will be those who stay on the road.
title: Tres mujeres

overview: Upon discovering she has a terminal illness, Paula, a thriving businesswoman, reassesses her life. Resigning from her job, she dedicates time to her three children. Paula buys a food truck for a family adventure. Their adventure begins in a village with a family estate, sparking a clash with Pepe's family, proprietors of a local eatery. Despite initial tension, Paula and Pepe, a man of noble character, are mutually attracted. Paula's illness, buried family secrets, and challenges confronting her children navigate them through an intricate path, fortifying their love. Determined to survive, Paula opts for a complex surgery.
title: Tu Vida Es Mi Vida

overview: Marisa, a brave and hard-working young mother, moves to New York City, following her young son's dream. While there, she lives out situations typical of all immigrants, but a twist of fate and confusion lead her to true love with Cristobal. When everything seems to start coming together for this love story to take place, the jealousy and envy of others strives to separate them. Will the strength of their love be powerful enough to help them come out unscathed from all their challenges and battles so they can declare victory once and for all?
title: Una Maid en Manhattan

overview: Velo de Novia is a telenovela about Andrea Paz, a young woman with heart disease who receives a heart transplant and falls in love with the donor's fiancé, José Manuel, while being tormented by the ghost of her lost love, Ángeles, in a two-part story that explores love, revenge, and identity with supernatural elements.
title: Velo de Novia

overview: A portray of the Mexican youth at the early 90s.
title: Mágica juventud

overview: Esther, Julia, Celeste and Margarita have known each other for many years and share a dream of getting ahead in life. Tragedy puts them in a vulnerable position. Esther loses her only son in an accident; Julia faces her husband's disappearance and Margarita dies, leaving María del Rayo, "Ray", orphaned. Celeste is diagnosed with a terminal disease, right at the time when she fulfills her dream of getting pregnant. This is how destiny is putting these four women´s resilience to the test.
title: Vencer la Ausencía

overview: The story of four women: Manuela, Amanda, Paloma, and Yaneli; their destinies intertwine when Dulce, a young woman they barely knew, mysteriously disappears. Together they will look for Dulce without imagining that they will overcome multiple obstacles to solve the mystery. In that search, a solid friendship will develop, which will help each one overcome their guilt. Together they will discover that sorority is their greatest strength.
title: Vencer la Culpa

overview: Four women of different ages face current social issues and must overcome numerous hurdles, learning to conquer their greatest fears. Inés is under her husband's yoke. Cristina undergoes an abuse. Areli is starting to discover her sexuality and feels uncomprehended. Marcela steals a car, unaware that an important businessman's corpse is inside the trunk. At 15 years old, she ends up in a Juvenile Detention Center charged with robbery and being a suspect in a murder she didn't commit.
title: Vencer el Miedo

overview: Verano de Amor is the story of four teenagers who have always lived in the city of Tlacotalpan, Veracruz, Mexico. The story's message emphasizes the distinction between the importance of pursuing one's dreams and the importance of pursuing material things.
title: Verando de Amor

overview: Three Victorinos - who were born on the same day, year, month and hour - will be united by the same fate. The day they meet in the place where they were born, one of them will die. Find out which of the three will have a tragic end!
title: Victorinos

overview: A British music interview show that has featured presenters including Melanie Blatt, Dave Berry and Alice Levine.
title: The Hot Desk

overview: The story of four women of different ages and social strata are forced to coexist in the same house. At first, their interaction is awkward and strained due to their different perspectives and approaches to life. But gradually, sorority and sympathy prevails as they realize their unique bond: somehow, they have all experienced their respective partners' absence and abandonment.
title: Vencer el Desamor

overview: Years ago, Gonzalo Rivas-Montaño was engaged to Olga Bocker, but when he met her sister, Elena, they fell in love. However, Olga's wickedness managed to separate them and turned the entire town against her sister. Elena died shortly after, leaving Gonzalo devastated; he eventually married Olga and they had a daughter, Hanna. In the present, Andrea Rosales is a kind and generous young woman who has lived her entire life in the small mining town of Real del Monte. At the beginning of the story, Andrea is about to marry Manuel Soto, a handsome mining engineer. However, Daniel González Rivas-Montaño, a young and idealistic journalist who never imagined he had ties to Real del Monte, arrives in town. Daniel arrives in town in search of his grandfather, Don Gonzalo Rivas-Montaño, whom he has never met. The reason is that his mother, Hanna Rivas-Montaño Bocker de González, hates his father, holding him responsible for his mother's suicide. Daniel meets Andrea and the two fall in love, leading Andrea to break off her engagement to Manuel. For many of the townspeople, their love is reminiscent of the story of Gonzalo and Elena, and it seems history is about to repeat itself
title: Atrévete a Olvidárme

overview: Russian chefs will travel to Asia to test themselves in extreme conditions. They will search for and source their own ingredients for the dishes, and ultimately prepare a dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant.
title: Последний шеф

overview: Living in Asagaya, 29-year-old Hiroto Ikuta spends his days working at his part-time job and chatting with the locals. He likes visiting Hanae Wada most, a grumpy yet kind elderly woman whom Hiroto calls "Granny." Hiroto's time with Granny is sadly cut short when she passes away from a heart attack. To his surprise, Hiroto inherits Granny's house as she never married or had children. Three months later, 18-year-old Natsumi Kobayashi moves from her hometown to attend art school. With nowhere else to go, she stays with her cousin Hiroto, whom she has not seen in years. Despite their opposing personalities, the pair begin living under the same roof as they struggle through their seemingly mundane lives.
title: Hirayasumi

overview: Titans of the Cold War is an eight-part documentary series that charts the epic geopolitical struggle between The United State of America and the Soviet Union as told through the eyes of the era's most commanding figures. From World War II to the dissolution of the U.S.S.R, it centers on two titans, leaders whose choices, ideologies, and rivalries shaped the fate of the world.
title: Titans of the Cold War

overview: The National Lottery: On the Spot was a lively BBC One Saturday-night game and entertainment show hosted by Des O'Connor and Suzi Perry. Filmed on location around the UK, the series brings surprise challenges, feel-good moments, and audience participation to real people "on the spot," all wrapped around the National Lottery draw.
title: The National Lottery: On the Spot

overview: A free-spirited woman who died back in the Roaring Twenties, now an angel looking to earn her wings, is sent to Earth in the 1980s to help the Preston family as their housekeeper after the mother's untimely death.
title: Down to Earth

overview: Ruby Wax hosts The Waiting Game, where teams face timed trivia challenges in which patience becomes part of the strategy. The longer a contestant waits before buzzing in, the greater the potential reward — but hesitate too long and the risk increases. The show mixes quick thinking with calculated nerve, as teamwork, timing and judgement prove just as important as general-knowledge know-how.
title: The Waiting Game

overview: Mark Durden-Smith and David Flatman present highlights of the weeks rugby matches.
title: Rugby Highlights

overview: The series tells the story of Ana, a young showgirl at a strip club, who dreams of making it big in show business. Ana spent her childhood in an orphanage, and her deepest desire is to have a family. She has a boyfriend, Tony, who seems to love her but is a rather useless scoundrel. By chance, she ends up at the home of Fernando, a widowed banker with seven children, where she's mistaken for the new nanny. Ana likes the idea and decides to keep the job. The new nanny will fill the quiet of this large family with life and excitement, although at night she'll continue working on the show, secretly leading a double life.
title: Ana y los 7

overview: Ana e os Sete is a sitcom, designed for family entertainment, whose central theme is family, youth, and childhood conflicts. Henrique Vilar is a distinguished banker who became a widower about a year ago and has seven children aged between six and seventeen. Since his wife's death, he has been looking for a governess to take care of his children's education, but they are not very interested in having someone in their mother's place, always devising schemes that cause the candidates to leave after a few days. Ana Cruz is a very attractive woman who has always dreamed of being an actress, but has had little luck in the art of acting, despite competing in all the auditions. Advised by Tino, her best friend and long-time boyfriend, she supports herself as a stripper at the Chicago Club, where she anxiously awaits a film producer who will see her and recognise her talent. Tired of her current life and aware that her job as a stripper won't last forever, Ana goes to an employment agency where a mix-up occurs, and she's directed to the Vilar Mansion, where the 16th nanny has just left!
title: Ana e os Sete

overview: Petra Mede takes us on a colorful journey through time through SVT's archives to some of our Swedish cities.
title: Så byggdes din stad

overview: Legends of the Montreal Canadiens transcend stats and trophies; three icons - an artist, warrior, and agitator - exemplify the team's spirit through their untold stories of triumph and struggle.
title: Toujours Canadiens

overview: Whammy! The All-New Press Your Luck is a revival of the classic game show in which contestants answer trivia questions to earn spins on a giant game board filled with cash, prizes, and the dreaded "Whammies" — animated characters that can wipe out a player's winnings. Hosted by Todd Newton, the series keeps the original show's risk-and-reward gameplay while updating the look and pacing for a modern audience.
title: Whammy! The All-New Press Your Luck

overview: Chuck Woolery: Naturally Stoned is a reality series that follows game show host Chuck Woolery at work and at home, offering a behind-the-scenes look at his life, career, and relationships while balancing hosting duties on Lingo with personal projects and family moments.
title: Chuck Woolery: Naturally Stoned

overview: How Much Is Enough? sees four contestants compete to win money from a shared cash meter. As the meter rises, players secretly decide when to lock in — but the longer they wait, the higher the risk that someone else will take the money first. Strategy, timing, and nerve determine who walks away with the biggest share, while the player judged to be the "greediest" leaves with nothing.
title: How Much Is Enough?
Les dossiers secrets de l'inspecteur Lavardin

overview: Beat the Star is a game show where a member of the public competes head-to-head against a celebrity across a series of physical and mental challenges. Each round tests different skills such as coordination, endurance, strategy, or trivia knowledge, with points awarded based on performance. The contestant plays for a cash prize, while the celebrity competes for charity. The format builds tension as the rounds increase in value, leading to a high-stakes final challenge that decides the overall winner. If the contestant loses, the prize money rolls over to the next episode, increasing the potential jackpot.
title: Beat the Star

overview: Isabella Muller-Reinhardt presents coverage of Germany's premier football league.
title: Bundesliga

overview: Randling is an Australian comedy panel and word-game series hosted by Andrew Denton. Two permanent teams of comedians, writers, broadcasters, and entertainers compete across a season-long tournament, facing off in a mix of wordplay challenges, linguistic puzzles, definitions, anagrams, and literary trivia. With quick wit, playful rivalry, and a warm, conversational tone, the show blends smart humor with a celebration of language, as guests test their vocabulary skills while trading jokes and storytelling.
title: Randling

overview: Experience the drama in drama's capital. Masks fall in the heart of İstanbul's magnificent streets, where a romantic film set quickly turns into a fierce reckoning of passion, rage, and jealousy.
title: An İstanbul Story

overview: Anna, the underdog on the national team, gets the chance to train as Maria's ski partner, the enigmatic queen of skiing, and she jumps at the chance. The women are coached by the ruthless Kim, who only cares about results. Anna and Maria play a dark, psychological game where they compete against each other, but also need each other to reach the top. The closer Anna gets to the top, the higher the price of success. In the end, there can only be one winner.
title: Kylmä kausi

overview: A 3-episode drama documentary about the Danish industrialist Mærsk McKinney Møller who built the largest Danish conglomerate during the 1900's.
title: Dynastiet Mærsk

overview: Does a taxi have a magic price increase button? What does the money from the driver's commission go to? Who is watching the users in the salon? And what is hidden on the other side of the application? The Yandex.Taxi team will tell you how the service's technologies work, which protect drivers and passengers, quickly assign cars to order and consider a fair price for everyone.
title: Антология технологий Яндекс Такси

overview: A chance encounter leads to a romance between a billionaire and a maid with a difficult fate.
title: The Virgin and the Billionaire

overview: On the evening of March 19, 1942, an Allied aircraft carrying a covert operative known as the Believer arrived over Rangoon Airport, only to discover upon landing that the airfield had already fallen into Japanese hands. The aircraft immediately attempted to take off again, but the following day the highest authorities received an AAAA-level telegram reporting that the plane had been shot down, triggering widespread panic. The Believer's mission was to deliver an ultra-top-secret operational plan and encrypted contact codes to the supreme command of the China Theater. The authorities ordered military intelligence to locate the missing aircraft and the Believer at all costs. Carried by the Believer were the complete details of the operation, including the communication codes linking the Pacific aircraft carrier task force and the bomber squadrons assigned to carry out the strike. Should these documents fall into Japanese hands, not only would the plan to bomb Tokyo collapse, but the entire escort fleet would be left like lambs to the slaughter. Wounded, the Believer parachuted into the sea and landed on Sanzao Island, home to a Japanese Navy Sixth Air Base. There, the operative was rescued and hidden by local islanders.
title: River Sunset

overview: Coverage and highlights of the latest motorsport action.
title: Motorsport UK

overview: During the Republican era, bone-inspection master, Mr. Cao, and his apprentice Zheng Yu are summoned to the Wang family estate to perform a ritual examination, only to find themselves framed and ensnared in a bloody, baffling murder case. Fighting to clear their names and seek justice, master and apprentice embark on a path of retribution. What they uncover is a heart-wrenching tragedy, born of a cruel and unforgiving era.
title: Bone Ritual

overview: Six Dutch celebrities solve a fictional murder, with a new theme and location each week. Both the victim and the perpetrator are also well-known Dutch people who have received an invitation.
title: Moordfeest

overview: Eight notorious reality stars move into a villa where they challenge, manipulate, and sabotage each other to be crowned the ultimate Supervillain and take home the cash prize of €25,000.
title: House of Villains

overview: Led by Gerard Joling and Ruben Nicolai, the participants will race down the slope in their carts in a winter wonderland atmosphere. It promises to be a true spectacle of light in the beautiful Winter Wonderland of the Efteling, full of snow, warm fires, and a large audience. The slope is steep, and their brakes will need to be strong this year, which will be made even more difficult by the thick layer of ice on the track.
title: Te land, ter zee en in de lucht Winterspecial
